_comment: The archetype keys the golden world's IR uses, one per distinct entity kind, expressed in the US-UB1 taxonomy (5 roots: building/npc/item/prop/terrain). This is the coverage contract for the bundled placeholder pack (US-UB2): every key here MUST resolve against PlaceholderPack.BuildLayer() with zero unbound, so any imported world is instantiable out of the box. Mirrors the Godot golden-ir (a settlement world: terrain + roads, zoned buildings with interiors, NPCs, items, props) mapped onto the Unity roots. Regenerate alongside the IR->key exporter (US-UB3); do not add keys under an unknown root.
